item.title: minulla ei ole alkoholiongelmaa... | Huppari
item.description: A soft, midweight hoodie that reads like a small, dry laugh you can wear. The clean white fleece and minimal black text create a quietly bold look — the kind of piece you pull on for late-night walks, low-key meetups, or long recovery weekends. The roomy kangaroo pocket and double-lined hood cradle you on chilly days. Thoughtful details — no side seams for a smooth silhouette, color-matched drawcord, and tear-away label — keep comfort front and center. The printed message sits calm and centered on the chest, speaking to someone who prefers wry honesty over loud slogans. Built to last with a sturdy 50/50 cotton–poly blend and resilient DTF/DTG prints, this hoodie ages well and stays wearable when you need it most.Product features- Cozy 50/50 cotton–poly fleece (8.0 oz/yd²) for warmth and softness- Seamless tubular knit for a smooth, clean silhouette- Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord and roomy kangaroo pocket- Durable DTF/DTG and optional embroidery prints that hold up over time- Tear-away label, OEKO‑TEX dyes, and ethically sourced cottonCare instructions- Tumble dry: medium- Iron, steam or dry: low heat- Do not dryclean- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)- Non-chlorine: bleach as needed
